explanation: Shrunk to 2 bodies at rest, masses 1 and 17.5, distance ~1.49, G 1.279, dt 0.006. Softened gravity requires m1*a1 = -m2*a2, so net momentum stays zero. After 1 step body0 speed 0.0574 momentum ~0.057, body1 speed 0.00295 momentum ~0.0517 opposite, leaving net momentum 0.00574 > allowed 0.00111. Equalizing masses removes violation, showing pairwise force not antisymmetric when masses differ.
vision_note: Two bodies are stacked vertically near center - a large blue dot on top and a small blue dot below. From step 0 to step 1 there is almost no visible displacement, so the expected equal-and-opposite infall and momentum balance is not apparent.
